analyst_view.overall: Leaders PSG (1st, 26 pts, five league wins in a row) host Lorient (10th, 16 pts) on Saturday evening, three days after a Champions League home game against Roma on Wednesday. Luis Enrique's squad came into the Nice game (won 3-2) with Kvaratskhelia out long-term and Marquinhos, Dembele, Nuno Mendes, Akliouche and Doue all listed as doubts or absent by two outlets; the numbers list no missing players for PSG. With a Champions League game in midweek, Luis Enrique has tended to rotate in the league, and the numbers' recent PSG momentum (21 goals and 58 shots on target in six) is based on a hot run. I found no fresh team news for Lorient, so news on them was thin; no referee is named. I lean slightly lower on PSG's attacking numbers for rotation and the injury list.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.0 goals, 2.1 for PSG, already lifted by PSG's 21 goals in their last six. With Roma on Wednesday and several attackers (Dembele, Doue, Akliouche) doubtful as of last week, a rotated PSG side is likely, so I lean slightly lower, 3.0 to about 2.9.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.6 corners, 6.5 for PSG. Even a rotated PSG side keeps the ball and pushes Lorient back, and one preview noted PSG had won fewer than eight corners a game in a recent spell, which the numbers already see, so I stay at about 9.6.

cards.text: The numbers say 2.7 cards, already low because PSG have picked up only 3 cards in their last six and both sides are calm in this fixture. No referee is named and there is nothing at stake beyond the points, so I stay at 2.7.

shots.text: The numbers say 27.6 shots, already boosted 10% for PSG's recent run of 105 shots in six. A midweek Champions League game and a long injury list in attack make some rotation likely, so I lean slightly lower, 27.6 to about 26.5.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.2 shots on target, with PSG's figure lifted 13% for an unusually sharp run (58 on target in six). A changed PSG front line after Roma is unlikely to keep that pace fully, so I lean slightly lower, 10.2 to about 9.8.
